decisions.reason: As a flagship cloud transactional email service central to the firm's multichannel direction, its strategic value remains high and the marginal cost of keeping it on the firm's existing infrastructure is low.
Customer references show its value is being realized in document workflows, which justifies further commitment rather than abandonment.
The conversion service runs cheaply on the established email and fax platform and keeps the option open for regulated customers who still rely on fax, though its long-term prospects are uncertain.
The feature is integrated into the core fax service, so keeping it costs little, even as fax demand slowly declines.
Sandbox threat protection addresses rising security demand and complements the email security suite, so its value is likely to grow at modest keeping cost.
